LARA-GENERAL-001: An unexpected Lara error occurred. Check the logs and retry.
LARA-CONFIG-001: The configuration file at {path} could not be read. Verify the path and TOML syntax.
LARA-CONFIG-002: Required configuration key '{key}' is missing from {path}. Restore it from the reference config.
LARA-CONFIG-003: Configuration key '{key}' has invalid value {value} in {path}. Restore a positive value within the documented range.
LARA-UPSTREAM-001: The upstream source revision does not match the pinned commit. Fetch the pinned revision before continuing.
LARA-MODEL-001: A required checkpoint is missing. Download the pinned BF16 file and verify its checksum.
LARA-MODEL-002: Checkpoint verification failed. Delete only the affected file and download it again.
LARA-MODEL-003: Safetensors header at {path} is invalid: {reason}. Replace the affected checkpoint and retry.
LARA-MODEL-004: Tensor {name} uses unsupported dtype {dtype}. Use the official BF16 checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-005: Tensor {name} contains {actual} bytes but its shape and dtype require {expected}. Replace the corrupted checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-006: Tensor {name} byte range {start}:{end} exceeds file size {file_size}. Replace the truncated checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-007: Expected every tensor to use {expected}, but {count} tensors differ; first mismatch: {first}. Use the primary BF16 checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-008: Tensor payloads {first} and {second} overlap. Replace the malformed checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-009: Mapping template could not be written to {path}. Check the output path and permissions, then retry.
LARA-MODEL-010: Required checkpoint tensor {name} is absent from {path}. Verify the pinned model revision and mapping manifest.
LARA-MODEL-011: Loaded tensor {name} has dtype {actual_dtype} and shape {actual_shape}, but expected {expected_dtype} and {expected_shape}. Replace the shard or correct the mapping.
LARA-MODEL-012: Checkpoint key {name} appears in both {first} and {second}. Use a non-overlapping official shard set before mapping.
LARA-MODEL-013: The Hugging Face access probe could not reach the model service. Check network access and retry; no model payload was downloaded.
LARA-MODEL-014: Checkpoint mapping is incomplete or unreadable at {source_key}. Assign every source key to a reviewed MLX target and retry.
LARA-MODEL-015: More than one source tensor maps to MLX target {target_key}. Keep exactly one source for each target.
LARA-MODEL-016: Checkpoint mapping requests unsupported transform {transform}. Use a documented transform and review its shape.
LARA-MODEL-017: Checkpoint mapping targets do not match the MLX component. Missing: {missing}; unexpected: {unexpected}. Review the component mapping.
LARA-MODEL-018: Checkpoint source {source_file}:{source_key} appears in more than one mapping rule. Keep one reviewed rule per source tensor.
LARA-MODEL-019: Transforming tensor {name} with shape {shape} requires a two-dimensional tensor. Review the mapping transform.
LARA-MODEL-020: Mapped MLX target {target_key} has shape {actual_shape}, but expected {expected_shape}. Correct the mapping transform or component configuration.
LARA-MODEL-021: Mapped source shard {file} is unavailable. Provide the verified shard before constructing this component.
LARA-MODEL-022: More than one provided shard is named {file}. Use uniquely named official shards to avoid ambiguous mapping.
LARA-MODEL-025: Checkpoint source {source_key} has shape {actual_shape}, but the reviewed DurationHead layout requires {expected_shape}. Use the pinned official shard and mapping.
LARA-MODEL-026: LoRA adapter pair {key} is incomplete or incompatible with the pinned transformer weight. Use the matching official BF16 adapter and base checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-027: LoRA strength {value} is invalid. Use a finite non-negative stage strength.
LARA-MODEL-028: Transformer-block mapping entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed production AV layout. Use the pinned 22B BF16 transformer checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-029: Gemma feature-extractor entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed BF16 projection layout. Use the pinned Gemma checkpoint and keep tokenizer assets separate.
LARA-MODEL-030: Latent spatial-upscaler entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed x2 BF16 layout. Use the pinned official upscaler checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-031: Audio VAE core entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed BF16 layout. Use the pinned official Audio VAE checkpoint; vocoder and BWE tensors use a separate loader.
LARA-MODEL-032: Audio vocoder/BWE entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed BF16 waveform layout. Use the pinned official Audio VAE/vocoder checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-033: Transformer output entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed video/audio projection layout. Use the pinned 22B BF16 transformer checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-034: Transformer input entry {key} is missing or incompatible with the reviewed video/audio conditioning layout. Use the pinned 22B BF16 transformer checkpoint.
LARA-MODEL-035: Gemma 4 text-core configuration or mapping is incompatible ({reason}). Use the pinned official packed BF16 encoder and regenerate its reviewed mapping.
LARA-MODEL-036: Packed Gemma tokenizer asset {asset} is missing or invalid. Restore the pinned official BF16 encoder and verify its checksum.
LARA-RUNTIME-001: BF16 memory capacity was exceeded. Reduce dimensions or use a supported larger-memory machine; automatic quantization was not applied.
LARA-RUNTIME-002: CUDA is unavailable. Start a GPU instance and retry.
LARA-RUNTIME-003: Metal is unavailable. Run this probe on a supported Apple Silicon Mac with the pinned MLX environment.
LARA-RUNTIME-004: The estimated BF16 allocation is {estimated_bytes} bytes, above the configured budget of {budget_bytes} bytes. Reduce the shape or close other applications before retrying.
LARA-RUNTIME-005: The official CUDA golden pipeline could not validate its inputs, temporal grid, or output. Inspect the captured log, verify the pinned BF16 model pack and supported dimensions, then retry.
LARA-RUNTIME-006: The CUDA reference media artifact is missing, invalid, or lacks the required video and audio streams. Inspect the pipeline log and regenerate the artifact.
LARA-RUNTIME-007: The native MLX-LM text runtime is unavailable. Install the locked project dependencies on a supported Apple Silicon Mac.
LARA-SAMPLING-001: The LTX sigma schedule is invalid ({reason}). Use positive steps/token count, finite shifts and a terminal strictly between zero and one.
LARA-SAMPLING-002: The CFG/STG guidance request is invalid ({reason}). Check scales, pass predictions and transformer block indices.
LARA-SAMPLING-003: The res_2s sampling request is invalid ({reason}). Check the decreasing sigma schedule, modalities, eta and sampler settings.
LARA-PARITY-001: Tensor shapes differ: reference={reference_shape}, candidate={candidate_shape}. Verify layout mapping before comparing values.
LARA-PARITY-002: The fixed CUDA audio-boundary input or capture key {key} is unavailable or invalid. Restore the approved boundary artifact and retry.
LARA-PARITY-003: The fixed CUDA LoRA fusion input or capture key {key} is unavailable or invalid. Restore the approved LoRA boundary artifact and retry.
LARA-TENSOR-001: Frequency tensor shapes differ ({left} versus {right}). Regenerate both tensors from the same position grid.
LARA-TENSOR-002: Frequency batch {frequency_batch} cannot broadcast to input batch {input_batch}. Regenerate frequencies for this batch.
LARA-TENSOR-003: Rotary feature size {size} is odd. Use an even attention head dimension.
LARA-TENSOR-004: Unsupported rotary layout {rope_type}. Select split or interleaved.
LARA-TENSOR-005: Position grid has {dimensions} dimensions but {max_positions} maxima were configured. Correct the position metadata.
LARA-TENSOR-006: AdaLN table shape {table_shape} is incompatible with timestep shape {timestep_shape}. Verify the block configuration and timestep embedding.
LARA-TENSOR-007: The 3D neighborhood-attention request is invalid ({reason}); received shape/value {shape}. Verify Q/K/V layout, kernel, causal axes, and configured mask budget.
LARA-TENSOR-008: {stream} cross-attention needs both scale/shift and gate timestep tensors. Recreate preprocessing outputs for this block.
LARA-TENSOR-009: VAE norm layer {norm_layer} is unsupported. Select pixel_norm or group_norm for this MLX block.
LARA-TENSOR-010: VAE depth-to-space stride {stride} is incompatible with {channels} channels. Use dimensions and channel counts that preserve the configured block layout.
LARA-TENSOR-011: VAE space-to-depth settings (input channels {in_channels}, output channels {out_channels}, stride {stride}) are incompatible. Use channel counts and input dimensions that preserve the configured block layout.
LARA-TENSOR-012: VAE patch layout (shape {shape}, spatial patch {patch_size_hw}, temporal patch {patch_size_t}) is invalid. Use positive patch sizes that divide the input dimensions and channel layout.
LARA-TENSOR-013: VAE decoder block {block_name} is unsupported or has incompatible channels. Use a reviewed non-attention block configuration and valid channel multiplier.
LARA-TENSOR-014: Timestep-conditioned VAE block {block_name} did not receive a valid timestep embedding. Recreate the decoder conditioning input and retry.
LARA-TENSOR-015: Diffusion VAE pixel-shuffle stride {stride} is incompatible with {channels} channels. Use a valid three-axis stride and divisible channel reduction.
LARA-TENSOR-016: The Diffusion VAE decoder configuration or input layout is invalid. Check stage dimensions, timestep schedule, and context/noise shapes, then retry.
LARA-TENSOR-017: Duration-head setting {field} is invalid. Use positive dimensions and a pooler hidden size divisible by its head count.
LARA-TENSOR-018: Duration-head inputs are invalid ({reason}). Provide one or both rank-3 connector token tensors with the configured feature widths and matching batch sizes.
LARA-TENSOR-019: Gemma feature inputs are invalid (hidden={hidden_shape}, mask={mask_shape}). Use hidden states shaped [batch, tokens, 3840, 49] and a matching rank-2 mask.
LARA-TENSOR-020: Transformer output inputs are invalid (hidden={hidden_shape}, timestep={timestep_shape}). Use matching rank-3 tensors with the configured hidden width.
LARA-TENSOR-021: Transformer conditioning input is invalid ({reason}). Provide patchified latent tokens, per-token timesteps, position bounds, projected context and matching masks.
LARA-TENSOR-022: Gemma token input is invalid ({reason}). Provide a non-empty prompt batch with matching rank-2 token IDs and contiguous left-padding masks.
LARA-TENSOR-023: The latent spatial-upscaler input or configuration is invalid ({shape}). Provide a rank-5 NCTHW latent with 128 channels and the reviewed x2 configuration.
LARA-TENSOR-024: The Audio VAE decoder input or configuration is invalid ({shape}). Provide a rank-4 latent with 8 channels and the pinned causal decoder configuration.
LARA-TENSOR-025: The audio vocoder mel input is invalid ({shape}). Provide a rank-4 stereo tensor shaped [batch, 2, frames, 64].
LARA-TENSOR-026: The BWE waveform input is invalid ({shape}). Provide a rank-3 stereo waveform shaped [batch, 2, samples].
LARA-TENSOR-027: The BWE residual shape {residual_shape} does not match the resampled skip shape {skip_shape}. Verify the pinned sample rates, hop length and checkpoint configuration.
LARA-TENSOR-028: Transformer block {block_index} has no active video or audio stream. Enable at least one valid modality before denoising.
